# Instruction

sealed interface [Instruction](index.html)

A unit of instruction provided to an [LlmAgent](../-llm-agent/index.html).

Use one of the variants:

  * [Text](-text/index.html) for a single literal string (most common).

  * [Structured](-structured/index.html) for a pre-built, possibly multimodal [Content](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-content/index.html).

  * [Provider](-provider/index.html) for instructions that must be resolved per turn from a [ReadonlyContext](../-readonly-context/index.html).




Convenience factories on the companion object allow the call sites `Instruction("text")`, `Instruction(content)`, and `Instruction { ctx -> ... }`.
